Name: Pear Tree
Author: aranol
Description:
Adds a pear sapling, tree, and fruit. The sapling can be bought from the traveling merchant (appears randomly from Year 2 onwards), the tree bears fruit in the fall. This can all be adjusted by changing the values in the json files.

When I first started playing SDV, I named my farm Pear Orchard... little did I know. After countless gameplay hours spent in a painfully pearless orchard, it was time to take matters into my own two hands.

Working on:
- [s]Translations[/s] Added in 2.3
- Improved fruit sprite
- Improved position of fruit on tree
- More images/screenshots
- More accurately colored artisan goods

Uses a template by Rokugin, found here: https://github.com/rokugin/StardewMods/tree/main/ContentPatcherExamples
Also borrows some code from ItsBenter's Earlier Blue Grass: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21135
Thank you everyone in the SDV Modding discord for helping me :)

Downloads.Description: Add pear sapling, tree, and fruit. Added update key, fixed appearance rate and removed a bit of obsolete code.
